section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1996
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1996 N.C.R.B.(M.H.A.) 2.2.7 The age-distribution of population (per cent) of the country as per 1991 census revealed 37.3 per cent children's population (upto 14 years) and 6.7 per cent adults population (above 60 years). Comparatively children and adults constituted 9.2 per cent & 8.3 per cent respectively in the proportion of victims of accidental deaths (Table-4A). In general, males constituting nearly 71 per cent of total victims were at a greater risk from accidents than females.
